metadata.title: Phaksha Bexuk | Pork with Dried Red Chilies | Bhutanese style
metadata.description:
Phaksha bexuk is a Bhutanese style pork recipe, where pork is cooked tender with vegetable of your choice. Usually mountain vegetable are used to make this recipe and you can choose to use any vegetable of your choice. 

Music Credits: Clear Air - Somewhere Sunny by Kevin MacLeod is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution license (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)
Source: http://incompetech.com/music/royalty-free/index.html?isrc=USUAN1100626
Artist: http://incompetech.com/
This tender pork dish is a good side to steamed rice.
